title: v0.13.2
excerpt: Fixed 🔓 Chat over plain HTTP. Opening Open WebUI over plain HTTP at a LAN or Docker address now loads new and existing chats instead of staying on a spinner with "crypto.randomUUID is not a function". #33919 📝 Comments and Markdown editing over plain HTTP. Creating, replying to and editing comments, and editing Markdown files containing rendered blocks such as Mermaid diagrams or callouts, no longer fail with the same UUID error. Commit 🎛️ Side Chat permission switch. The Allow Side Chat switch is now visible even when Temporary Chat is off, so administrators can configure the two permissions independently. #33920
